Subject: Purchase path & next steps — Redwood pilot (Acme Cloud)

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + asks so we have a single place to track next steps for the pilot procurement path. High-level items we covered:

- Preferred commercial path: you mentioned preference for a PO-based pilot rather than card for vendor onboarding.
- Marketplace interest: you asked whether we can list on AWS Marketplace; noted that's possible but has additional lead time and paperwork — likely separate from this pilot.
- Core approvals needed: Legal (contract/SOW), Security (questionnaire + evidence), Finance (vendor onboarding / PO issuance).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW), Redwood_pricing_estimate.csv (pilot pricing estimate).

Asks from our side to confirm timing and owners so we can build a mutual action plan:
1) Can you confirm that Acme will / prefers PO issuance for the pilot? (Yes/No)
2) Who are the approvers/points of contact for Legal, Security, and Finance (full name + email)?
3) Does Acme require a W-9 / vendor onboarding packet before PO issuance? If yes, any specific fields we should prefill?
4) Are you interested in pursuing AWS Marketplace onboarding concurrently, or is that a later phase?

Suggested initial timeline (we can adjust based on your internal SLAs):
- Legal review of SOW: 5-7 business days after SOW receipt
- Security review / completed questionnaire: 5 business days (can run in parallel with legal)
- Finance vendor setup & PO issuance: 2-4 business days after approvals
- Target PO issuance window: ~10-15 business days from SOW finalization (pilot start date to follow)

If PO path is confirmed, we will produce a PO-ready SOW and work with Aditya on any pricing/discount questions. I copied Aditya to help coordinate SOW updates and any procurement paperwork.

I'll follow up with a short mutual action plan once you confirm the points above.

Thanks —
Camila

1) PO > card. We prefer a PO path for any vendor pilot that will touch production data.
2) Approvers / POCs: Legal: Tessa Wong (cc'd) — contract/SOW intake; Security: Mike Lancaster (security@acmecloud.com) — questionnaire owner; Finance: Raj Patel (raj.patel@acmecloud.com) — vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
3) Vendor onboarding: yes, we need a completed W-9 and vendor packet to start finance. I'll attach our PO template for your SOW team to use.
4) AWS Marketplace: interested, but we'd like to do the pilot via direct PO. Marketplace can be a later phase; if Redwood wants to pursue it in parallel that's fine but it won't speed this pilot's PO timeline.

Rough timeline from our side (estimates):
- Legal review of SOW: 5 business days once we have a final draft
- Security questionnaire + evidence collection: 5–7 business days (we can run this in parallel)
- Finance onboarding + PO issuance: 3–5 business days after legal/security sign-off
- Overall: 2–3 weeks is realistic for a simple pilot if SOW + vendor packet are complete

Attached: Acme_PO_template.docx (please populate SOW references where indicated).

Also, can you include Aditya and Rishi on pricing and any commercial questions?

Best,
Priya
